'''Ostrich Eggs''' are [[:Category:Animal Products|animal products]]  obtained from [[Ostrich]]es or by solving [[Journal Scraps#Journal Scrap #10|Journal Scrap #10]] on [[Ginger Island]]. It can also be found in [[Volcano Dungeon]] rare chests.

An Ostrich Egg can be placed in a [[Mayonnaise Machine]] to produce 10 [[Mayonnaise]]. The quality of the Mayonnaise will be equal to the quality of the Ostrich Egg used.

Putting an Ostrich Egg into an [[Ostrich Incubator]] in a [[Barn]] will hatch an Ostrich in {{duration|15,000m (9.5d)|class=inline}}. This is cut to {{duration|7,500m (4.75d)|class=inline}} with the [[Farming#Farming Skill|Coopmaster Profession]].

==Recipes==
Ostrich Eggs work the same as regular chicken [[Egg|eggs]] in all recipes.{{#lsth:Egg|Recipes}}
==Tailoring==
Ostrich Egg can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Warrior Helmet|class=inline}}. It can be used as a white [[Dyeing|dye]] when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
*[[Quests#Gus' Famous Omelet|"Gus' Famous Omelet"]]: On the Special Orders board in front of the [[Mayor's Manor]], [[Gus]] may randomly request that the player collect and deliver 24 Eggs (of any type) to the fridge in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]. The reward is {{Price|3000}} and a [[Mini-Fridge]].
*Five Eggs (any type, excluding Dinosaur) may be requested by the Raccoon at the [[Giant Stump]] as part of his third request, or as part of any request starting with the sixth.
